# Release Management

The Release Management layer of docturnal is responsible for managing archive hashes, model digests, and checksums for Ollama releases.

## Responsibilities

- Computes checksums for Ollama releases.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists archive hashes and files. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes checksums and writes digests. |  |

## How it works

- `scripts/archive-hashes.js`:
  - Lists archive hashes and files.
  - Defines functions like `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, and `field`.

- `scripts/update-models.js`:
  - Records model digests.
  - Defines functions like `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, and `main`.

- `scripts/update-ollama.sh`:
  - Computes checksums and writes digests.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
